verdict.rationale: TWC documents its own bulk capability: QuickFile, free installable software that reports wages for over 1000 employees directly from a formatted file. That is a genuine bulk operation, but it is limited to wage reporting and delivered through a desktop tool rather than an agent-accessible interface. The probes found no OpenAPI or llms.txt, and the apps.twc.texas.gov transaction host resets keyless agent connections. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond wage reporting, programmatic/API bulk endpoints, details on file format and batch limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
